about: Task 19: the boundary valve of operator_form_boundary_valve, picked once on ky10's prepared copy (public, bundled with WNTR) by the pre-registered rule in residualmap/intake_exp.py (every closable pipe closed in turn, a 7-day water-age run each; of the closures that keep every junction fed, the one that moves the scored day's mean age the most), then pinned in fixtures.py.
